dedupe_keys.name: processed numerical datasets supporting interpreting differential settlement mechanisms at railway bridge embankment transitions a numerical case study

description: A railway engineering team publishes processed numerical outputs for a bridge–embankment transition study. Zenodo lists nineteen public CSV figure datasets and a text README under CC BY 4.0. The files compare untreated, auxiliary-rail, unbound-granular-material and composite configurations through deviatoric stress, ballast and subbase strain, settlement versus axle-load cycles and differential settlement over one, two, six and ten years. These curves can benchmark transition-maintenance or deterioration models and compare intervention assumptions at the rail–bridge interface. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this set of processed profiles. A limitation is that the values are simulation outputs used for figures, not observed field settlement. The README says raw finite-element models, solver inputs and proprietary scripts are omitted, so the underlying run cannot be reproduced from this release alone. Site location, geometry and loading assumptions are not stated on the landing page. No CSV was downloaded and no profile value was recalculated.
